release_name: A monthly exposition was being shown every week
notes: Found by testing the occurrence-rule engine for the first time - 28 ruled rows evaluated across 1,249 dates against an independently written expectation. 26 were correct; 2 were wrong on 40 of 52 Fridays. row-0398 (Saint-Paul, Phoenix) and row-0399 (Saint-Patrice, Plaine Magnien) both carried First Friday only; Exposition du Saint-Sacrement in special_rule with occurrence_rule left empty. isOccurrenceRuleCandidate() deliberately rejects any special_rule mentioning exposition, adoration, celebration or prayer, so that a description is never mistaken for a schedule rule - but here the same string carried BOTH, so the rule was discarded and isRuleValidForDate() returned true for every Friday. The app advertised a monthly exposition all 52 weeks of the year. The exclusion is correct in principle and is unchanged; the ordinal now lives in occurrence_rule, which is what the field is for and what all 26 working rows already do. Verified: both rows now valid only on the first Friday (3 Sept, 1 Oct), and all 28 ruled rows pass across 1,249 date checks. A new gate check G9 fails the build if an ordinal is ever again left in special_rule beside an excluded word with no occurrence_rule. Both rows are Non-Mass, so they surface only when other celebrations are included. No Mass time changed: 426 rows.
